description: Command: moment-play/2.0 with one more optional member, `art` (Hub #679), and a test keeps the two schemas equal apart from `art`, `$id` and this description. `art` names a composition the target device holds as a private copy: the device plays that copy or refuses an unknown or expired reference before any effect, and `commandSupported` refuses the moment for a device that does not declare `moments.art`, so no device plays its mood instead. The core's automation sends it. The gateway builds every client's moment as 2.0, inbox send-again refuses a moment naming art, and a responder that plays art refuses any source but `bunny/core`, because the in-process bus checks none. Play one moment, a short presentation intent (ADR 0006, Hub #842). The envelope subject names the target device by its routing ID (validator, Hub #918); the payload names no device and carries no frames, raw protocol or text. `startAtMs` is on the runtime's wall clock, at most 60,000 ms after the envelope time; a module converts it to a deadline on its own monotonic clock when the request arrives, and drops the moment as missed when it is more than `toleranceMs` past it. A flourish never covers status. The reply and the outcome use the profile's reply and outcome payloads.
